_doc: Known-defect ledger of the PREVIOUS engine for scripts/db-proof/tbHandlerCharacterization.mjs (blueprint Revision 2 defect ledger; recorded in H2, kept by E1).

Each signature is the EXACT value the previous handler (process-trial-balance at engine_commit; its index.ts SHA-256 is handler_sha256, identical at main af8a96b and 9b0c2fd) produces for the probe's fixture, from a real-handler, real-PostgreSQL run.

Since E1 the gate runs THAT handler for these probes, beside the current one on the same database: a probe counts as 'defect reproduced' (never a pass) only when the previous handler's value equals this signature AND differs from the probe's independent oracle (bigint minor units, class-side table, computed in the test). This proves each fixture genuinely exercises its defect.
The current handler (E1) runs the same fixtures as REQUIREMENTS that must equal the oracle. Any other value fails the gate.

defects.assertion: cash total of three reviewed cash accounts equals their sum (file order 10,000.00 / 20,000.00 / 30,500.00)
cash total is independent of row order (reversed order)
no cash reconciliation is claimed (nothing independent was compared): cash_reconciliation is null
a reviewed current-asset credit named 'Closing stock' stays a (negative) current asset as mapped; nothing is moved into cost of goods sold
liabilities are summed class-side (credit positive) whatever the mapping's normal_balance; the equation difference is 0
an authoritative certification never carries a BALANCE_SHEET_EQUATION_FAILED exception (for this fixture the correct engine has no failure)
a genuine equation failure (a legacy reviewed mapping to a cash-flow class leaves 500.00 out of the statements) never becomes authoritative: the account needs review
a non-reporting decision cannot remove a non-zero balance: the upload needs review and nothing is authoritative
an equation-failure message states the difference at the currency's exponent (BHD: 3 decimals)
